cases.name: Direct detail resolution cannot win over cancellation inside its transport
Actual client invoker preserves cancellation before exposing its detail
Cancellation in a queued search continuation starts no detail request
Aborting an unresolved detail settles without a retry or late match
Owned deadline keeps unavailable distinct from human cancellation
Cancellation removes its caller listener, even with immediate transport resolution
